name: TileAction
description: Partition loop nests into smaller blocks to fit intermediate results in L1/L2 cache. Applies tiling to structured linalg operations (matmul, conv) or affine/scf loop nests. Tile size 0 means no tiling for that dimension.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: List of tile sizes for each loop dimension. Zero means no tiling for that dimension. Must have length matching the number of loops in the target operation.

parameters.name: operation_name
parameters.description: Optional: name or tag of the operation to tile. If not provided, targets the first tiling-eligible operation found. Common values: 'matmul', 'conv_2d_nchw_fchw'.
